notes:
Original acquired from https://postprint.nivel.nl/PPpp3147.pdf; title and DOI verified. Replication DOI landing inaccessible; OpenAlex identified Utrecht OA repository, but repository and linked full PDFs returned 403. No abstract-only statistics extracted. Self-efficacy F value preserved as printed in postprint text (12, 9); no metric conversion. The visually verified postprint prints the F value with a comma and space; its denominator df is retained without correction despite the stated complete sample of 180.
Source follow-up: Published 2014 article copy (DOI contains 2013). Target description requests a control comparison, but initial intervention was provided to all participants. Printed standardised initial-phase slope retained with target_match false. No frequentist same-test p printed; Bayesian 90% credibility intervals .01;.50 (proactive coping), .04;.59 (self-efficacy). PPP is model fit, not slope p. PDF10 rendered and checked. Narrative verdict concerns original intervention; booster added value uncertain.
Completion source review (n_r): The explicitly retained analytic sample is 141 participants and LGCM uses all available data; no sums of assessment counts or derivation from df. The located model has no untreated-control comparison, so target_match=false.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly describe effective initial-phase improvements maintained over more than a year, in line with previous findings. This narrative verdict does not establish an untreated-control contrast; boosters are discussed separately.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Table 1 explicitly labels standardised estimates; the outcome-named initial-phase β1 is .28. This is within-intervention growth, not the control contrast in the assigned description; target_match=false. Other phase-specific estimates are retained in notes.
